tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rta mgrin grub rgyal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge bzhugs so// padma kro dha na maḥ sindhūr lhun po'i spo la nyin byed kyis/ /lan brgyar byugs 'dra'i padma dbang gi lha/ /rab 'jigs gshin rje khros pa'i gar mkhan po/ /khyod la dad pas snying nas phyag bgyid do/ /'dir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi dpal rta mgrin dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba thob nas/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bha was chos thams cad stong par bsam la/ stong pa'i ngang las zla gam smug nag me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po bsam/ de las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas thod dbyug dkar po nam mkhar phyar bas bgegs dang 'byung po ma lus pa 'joms par byed pa/ g.yon pa sdig mdzub bsgreng ba la me dpung 'bar bas gnod byed thams cad gzhob tu bsreg pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig bgrad cing khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser 'khyog cing 'bar ba/ zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs shing rngams pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa'i spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thab dkris pa/ klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par byas te brgyan pa/ sbom zhing thung la lto ba 'phyang ba/

gshin rje khros pa'i nyams can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bdud bzhi mnan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol ba'i rdo rje'i sku/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hrīḥyig dmar po sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng me 'bar ba klog pa'i tshul du sems gtad nas/ oṃ badzra kro ta ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci nus bzlas/ 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ de nas ha ya gṛ wa sa pā ri wa ra sngon du 'gro ba'i argaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod dbul/ hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rta mchog sku/ /nyi ma'i 'od mtshungs nyon mongs sreg /bdud bzhi ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /dpa' bo rta mgrin phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ ci 'byor ba'i gtor ma bshams la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che bar gtor rdzas sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu i daṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod dang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /'di'i byin rlabs byed par 'dod pas/ maṇḍal padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'am/ me tog gi tshom bu'i steng du/ dpal gtor brgyan can/ dar dmar po'i cod paṇa dang bcas pa mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor ba bshams/

gong bzhin bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ mdun gyi gtor ma rta mgrin du bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams byas/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral du 'khod la/ maṇḍal/ thun mong gi gsol gdab/ kun mkhyen ye shes tshigs bcad/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ rgyun bshags rnams tshe dpag med kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya/ dngos gzhi la/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs/ lha dang sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba'i dpral ba nas oṃ dkar po dpag med 'phros/ slob ma'i spyi bor thim pas/ lus gang / lus kyi sdig sgrib dang bar chad thams cad dag par bsam la/ rtsa sngags brjod cing rol mo bya/ de bzhin du mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ sngon po spros/ ngag dang yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gsung dang thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ re re la yang rol mo sogs gong ltar bya/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gsung / gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba'i slob ma'i spyi bor byon pa'i steng du rtsa brgyud bla ma/ mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo dpa' mo sprin 'thibs pa ltar bsam la/ gtor ma mgor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo sogs rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyis mtshan nas brjod cing / khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dus da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim pas/ slob ma rta mgrin dngos su gyur pa ni mngon rtogs ltar gsal gdab/

de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po gyen du langs pa bsam/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥyis mthar/ sngags 'phreng g.yas skor du gnas pa las/ de 'dra'i sngags 'phreng mar me gcig las gnyis kyi rnam par mched de/ slob ma'i snying gar g.yon skor du 'khod/ de yang dang po dam tshig pa/ gnyis pa ye shes pa/ gsum pa rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa'i tshul du bsam la/ rtsa sngags lan gsum rjes bzlos bya/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing / bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang / slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes brjod/ rjes kyi yon dbul ba sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /padma mthar byed khro bo yi/ /sgrub thabs byin rlabs cho gar bcas/ /grub pa'i rgyal mo'i gzhung bzhin du/ /gsal bar bgyis pa'i dge ba des/ /bdud dpung mun tug mthar byas te/ /ye shes snang ba lam chen pos/ /bde ldan padmo'i kha phye ste/ /zung 'jug sbrang rtsir rol bar shog/ //ces pa 'di yang rje btsun rdo rings pa'i gsung las skyes pa'i rgyal khams pas las dang po la phan pa'i phyir du sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rta mgrin grub rgyal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
